meta.title: Area Converter — Convert Square Meter and More
meta.description: Free area converter for 10+ units including Square Meter, Square Kilometer, Square Centimeter. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Square meters, acres, hectares, square feet. Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 10 area units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for area in this tool is **m2**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most area conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this area converter?
**A:** It uses 10 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Square Meter (m²), Square Kilometer (km²), Square Centimeter (cm²), Square Millimeter (mm²), Hectare (ha), Acre (ac), Square Foot (ft²), Square Inch (in²), Square Yard (yd²), Square Mile (mi²).
